quickAction.description: Quick start that shapes the turn: forgotten_check always opens with a visible plan (#451).

replaceFromMessageId.description: Regenerate or edit-and-resend (#451): the id of the latest user message. That turn is replaced; its pending proposals are dismissed, never applied.

mode.description: deterministic_fallback means no model answered; the UI labels the reply as Basis-Modus.

stopped.description: false when the run had already ended.

reason.description: Only kept with a thumbs down.

acknowledgedCurrentValues.description: Re-baselines fields after a stale conflict: provenance key → the value the field holds now (from the 409 details). The write remains a compare-and-set.

value.description: The whole-euro amount — present only when kind === "erfasst" (erstattung may be negative).

calculationIncomplete.description: The computed side is incomplete (berechne returned "offen").

deadlineEnd.description: Einspruchsfrist-Ende (Bescheiddatum + 1 Monat), null until the datum is set.

remainingDays.description: Whole days left (negative = abgelaufen), null until the datum is set.

fields.description: The five figures, in paper order.

nextStates.description: The legal next sub-states (for the UI to offer only what is legal).

value.description: The whole-euro amount — present only when kind === "erfasst". Sign/validity per field is validated via @steuereule/core (erstattung may be negative).

receiptId.description: Der Beleg, aus dem der Wert stammt.

unconfirmed.description: Wie viele Werte dieser Anlage noch unbestätigt sind.

sozialversicherung.description: SV-Arbeitnehmeranteil (Summe Zeilen 23/23a/23b, 25, 26 und 27) in whole EUR.

receiptId.description: Optional receipt id for { kind: "beleg", receiptId } provenance.

overwriteExisting.description: Must be true to overwrite already captured LStB fields (ADR-0008).

actionIds.description: Staged advisor actionIds fulfilled by this confirmation.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation — must be exactly `true`. The mandatory pre-delete export offer and Löschschutz warning are a frontend/UX concern; this is the server-side confirmation gate.

password.description: Required only when the caller’s current session is not fresh enough (ADR-0013 §6) — re-verified via better-auth’s own password check, never a second hand-rolled one.

profile.description: False only when an active LegalHold on "profile" exempted the row — it still exists, retained under legal obligation.

account.description: Always true — the account (User, cascading Session/Account) and its Verification rows are always torn down; LegalHold never exempts login/identity itself.

retainedAnonymisedAuditRows.description: Count of TaxDataAccessLog rows anonymised (userId severed to an irreversible tombstone) by this call — retained as the Art. 30 accountability record, no longer person-linkable.

retainedUnderLegalHold.description: Count of rows retained untouched — neither erased nor anonymised — because an active LegalHold exempted them.

taxData.description: Every stored tax-data row, decrypted (Art. 15/20); empty when the caller has none.

query.description: Street, optionally followed by house number and place or postal code.

postalCode.description: Postal code the form already holds; its streets are listed first.

available.description: False when this deployment has no street data installed; `hits` is then always empty.

houseNumber.description: House number found in the query, for the form to take over.

userCode.description: The short code shown on the desktop and matched on the phone.

deviceCode.description: The RFC 8628 device_code — held by the desktop only, to poll POST /v1/device/token. Not a session credential; carries no authenticated power on its own.

verificationUriComplete.description: The full verification URL to encode as the QR code (includes the user_code as a query param).

expiresIn.description: Seconds until this code expires (ADR-0024: 2 minutes).

userAgent.description: The requesting desktop's raw User-Agent, or null if it was absent.

region.description: Country code from task 0b's geo-IP resolver, or "unknown" — never null once task 0/0b's write path has run.

requestedAt.description: When the desktop requested this code.

zveA.description: The primary zvE-basis (Einnahmen from @steuereule/core — layer 3 open, no real zvE yet).

zveB.description: The partner zvE-basis (query param — M1 does not yet collect it).

components.description: Which tax components are folded into both amounts.

single.description: Full assessed tax, single filing (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

joint.description: Full assessed tax, joint filing (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

provenance.description: Origin metadata on both numbers (only when kind !== "nicht-anwendbar").

reason.description: Why the comparison does not apply (only when kind === "nicht-anwendbar").

minimumRateEur.description: § 152 Abs. 2 Satz 2 AO — der Mindestzuschlag je angefangenem Monat, in Euro.

percentPerMonth.description: § 152 Abs. 2 Satz 1 AO — 0,25 % der festgesetzten Steuer je angefangenem Monat.

filingDeadline.description: Die Abgabefrist (§ 149 Abs. 2 AO), ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

today.description: Der Server-Stichtag in Europe/Berlin, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

level.description: keine | warnung (ab 60 Tage vor der Frist) | abgelaufen.

remainingDays.description: Whole days from heute (exclusive) to the frist; negative = abgelaufen.

lastYear.description: Das Quelljahr der Kopie — der Jahresbezug der Herkunft (ADR-022).

confirmed.description: false = UNBESTÄTIGT (kopiert, Anlage noch nicht bestätigt), true = bestätigt (ADR-021).

status.description: freigeschaltet = paid for this tax year; offen = payable; nicht-verfuegbar = payment is not configured on this environment.

missing.description: What stops the printout: missing Stammdaten keys, `ehegatte` (married, not yet supported), or an Anlage that is not printable yet (`anlageV`, `anlageKap`, `anlageNGre`, `anlageRAvBav`, `anlageRAus`). Empty = printable.

status.description: Current state of the background PDF rendering job.

statusUrl.description: Polling URL to check job progress.

downloadUrl.description: Download URL when status is completed.

childId.description: The year’s Kind row when the person is part of the year.

fromYear.description: Last earlier year the person was part of („aus 2025“).

preselected.description: Preselected for this year (last year’s people, children up to 25).

asksForEducation.description: From 18 the mask asks about education.

updatedBySelf.description: The last change was made by the requesting account.

same.description: true = the same person (merge), false = two people
